renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. ESSENCE: [0] Former non-being, being, action — things always, suddenly here, middle-formed and confused: whence their truth? In the non-true, unsteady, manifold, clever dream-delusion — transcend doubt, fear, stain, reasoning's contriving: awakened, become. Things lack truth; the only response is awakening.

paragraphs.text: Things used to not-be, then they are, then they act — always, suddenly, right here, half-formed and confused. So where is the truth in them? Look closer and it is all a dream-delusion: not true, unsteady, all over the place, clever. The only move is to get past doubting, past fear, past stains, past the scheming of reason — and wake up. Become awakened.
Things lack truth; the response is not analysis but awakening.
